# Boats

> Delegated USDC trading on Arc testnet. Captains trade through an on-chain mandate and stake first-loss capital. Public transactions trigger settlement at thresholds or the end date; prices, liquidity, transaction inclusion and contract risks remain.

AI agents can read boats, pre-check trades against the mandate, read Gemini prediction-market odds and act as captain or crew through the Boats MCP server or the TypeScript SDK.

The bundled captain uses deterministic rules, without an embedded LLM. MCP tools provide structured JSON and read/write annotations. Without a signer they return unsigned calls; pass caller for role and balance checks and read all warnings. Captain setup: create, stake, wait for crew to board, then sail. Check returned transaction hashes before retrying a partial failure.

## Docs

- [agent.json](https://boats-liard.vercel.app/agent.json): machine-readable claims, proof links, commands, prize integration and limitations; not a live state feed
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Villarley/boats/blob/main/AGENTS.md): lifecycle, who can call what, mandate rules, errors, addresses, MCP setup
- [MCP server](https://github.com/Villarley/boats/tree/main/packages/mcp): 14 tools: `boats_deployment`, `boats_list`, `boats_get`, `boats_score`, `boats_worst_case`, `boats_check_trade`, `boats_position`, `boats_my_positions`, `boats_activity`, `boats_odds`, `boats_odds_contracts`, `boats_create`, `boats_act`, `boats_tx_status`
- [Example agent session](https://github.com/Villarley/boats/blob/main/packages/mcp/examples/session.md)
- [Judge evidence guide](https://github.com/Villarley/boats/blob/main/docs/judging.md): reproduce five proofs with npm run verify:proof, without a key or a new transaction; memos are self-reported, not Gemini attestations
- [Economic whitepaper](https://github.com/Villarley/boats/blob/main/docs/whitepaper.md): first-loss equations, exact examples, fee vesting, integer rounding and implemented-versus-proposed controls, with source and verification links
- [Partner research](https://github.com/Villarley/boats/blob/main/docs/partner-research.md): source-backed submission strategy and acceptance criteria
- [@boats/sdk](https://github.com/Villarley/boats/tree/main/packages/sdk): reads, `checkTrade`, first-loss math, calldata builders, keeper, captain quickstart
- [Contracts](https://github.com/Villarley/boats/tree/main/contracts/src): `Boat.sol`, `BoatFactory.sol`, `PriceOracle.sol`, `SwapAdapter.sol`
- [Deployment](https://github.com/Villarley/boats/blob/main/app/src/config/arc-deployment.json): Arc testnet (chain 5042002) addresses

## HTTP API (this site)

- `GET /api/odds`: live Gemini odds used by the AI captain
- `GET /api/activity`: recent on-chain activity of all official boats
- `GET /api/captain-log`: the AI captain's decisions with transaction links
- `POST /api/keeper`: runs `checkVoyage()` / `returnToPort()` on every boat (header `x-keeper-secret`)

## Agent verification

- `npm run verify:agent`: eight offline synthetic scenarios through the production decision code; no network or signer, not a backtest
- MCP resources: `boats://playbook`, `boats://evidence`, `boats://proof-report`
- MCP prompt: `review_voyage` (boat, optional who and amountUsd); review first, unsigned plans only on explicit user request
- The bundled captain holds on one-sided or wide quotes (over five probability percentage points), closed markets and stale fetched snapshots. Bid/ask are exposed as raw decimal strings. This does not prove market depth, last-trade freshness or profitable trading.
